LanguageData.GR_AgePillsTaken.description: Recovering from age pills. Age pills are hard on the body's metabolism, and it takes at least a day before other pill can take effect.
LanguageData.GR_AgePillsTaken.label: age pills
LanguageData.GR_AnimalControlImplant.description: An installed animal controller implant. This implant will allow this creature to be drafted and controlled by the player.
LanguageData.GR_AnimalControlImplant.label: animal controller
LanguageData.GR_AvianGenetrainerEffect.description: This genetrainer gives the birdlike curiosity health state, increasing global learning speed.\n\nGenetrainers are implants that do not take the place of any given organ. Only one can be "installed" at a time. Using a second genetrainer will have no effect and the genetrainer will be wasted. Bear in mind that a genetrainer modifies the genes of the human subject, and only death will get rid of its effects.
LanguageData.GR_AvianGenetrainerEffect.label: avian genetrainer (birdlike curiosity)
